cases.name: engaged
observed_differences: Overall window positions and sizes are very close, including the left portrait window, right CINCO ID window, and lower console.
The clone's title-bar text and console text appear slightly heavier/sharper than the softer source rendering.
The left portrait window's active blue title-bar span is slightly shorter in the clone, with the Close area beginning a bit farther left.
The bottom control strip of the console is simplified/different in small widget details compared with the source.

cases.name: oyster
observed_differences: The overlapping OYSTER window is placed and sized almost identically, with only a few-pixel vertical difference.
The clone's chrome lines and title text are crisper/heavier than the blurred source.
Small title-bar button proportions differ slightly, especially the Close/button group on the OYSTER window.
The gradient/content area in the front OYSTER window appears a little cleaner and more uniform in the clone.

cases.name: intro
observed_differences: The single Tayne window matches the original placement and size very closely.
The clone's interior image area is cleaner and more horizontally scanlined, while the source is softer/blurrier.
Title-bar text and buttons are very close, though the clone's text appears slightly darker and sharper.

cases.name: tayne
observed_differences: The two side Tayne windows and central OYSTER window match the original layout and z-order closely.
The center orange logo panel is slightly cleaner and more saturated in the clone.
The title-bar typography in the clone is a bit bolder/sharper than in the source.
Small button dividers and bevels in the title bars are not quite as soft as the source.

cases.name: squat
observed_differences: The cascade of Tayne windows and the larger front/right window align very closely with the source.
The clone's title bars and borders are slightly crisper, with darker text than the source.
The visible stacked-window spacing is very close, but some rear window edges differ by a few pixels.

cases.name: hat
observed_differences: The nested portrait-window stack in the upper right is positioned and cropped very close to the source.
The lower console window matches position and size closely.
The clone's console text is sharper and slightly cleaner than the analog-blurred source.
Nested title-bar button details and bevel softness differ slightly.

cases.name: flar
observed_differences: The three tall Tayne windows are placed and sized almost identically.
In the source, the left window shows a visible vertical scrollbar/thumb along its right edge; the clone does not reproduce that scrollbar detail.
The clone's title bars are sharper and the title text is heavier than the softened source.
Interior content begins at a very similar height, but the clone's panel rendering is cleaner and more uniform.

cases.name: nsfw
observed_differences: The rear Tayne window and front NSFW dialog match the source placement, size, and overlap very closely.
The large NSFW text is very close in scale and position.
The clone is slightly sharper overall, with more distinct scanlines and darker chrome text.
Small title-bar button bevels are a little cleaner than in the source.

cases.name: call
observed_differences: The main Tayne window and centered incoming-call popup match the source layout closely.
The clone's main window interior is paler/yellower, while the source has a warmer peach/tan tint.
The popup shadow, red number display, and WIFE panel are very close, though the clone is sharper.
Title-bar and button details are close but slightly cleaner and less analog-soft in the clone.

cases.name: chaos
observed_differences: The dense stack of CINCO ID windows, the MOZARELL window, and the foreground error dialogs are reproduced with close overall placement and z-order.
The clone's foreground error dialog appears slightly cleaner and sharper, with heavier title-bar and message text.
Some stacked rear-window edges and offsets differ by a few pixels, especially in the lower cascaded area.
The source has softer analog-blurred chrome and text, while the clone uses crisper lines and more uniform scanlines.

limits: Perceptual model grades are estimates and vary across runs; source/clone screenshots and recordings are retained.
Timed replay uses cached generated Paul assets and real STT transcripts scheduled at reference response times; fresh generation latency is measured separately.
Scripted computer replies and canonical music are source recordings. Personalized name units and arbitrary novel speech are synthesized approximations.
Whole-person generated video only; no face overlays. The reviewed engaged Paul clip uses an authorized whole-body source pose and generated frames aligned to the reference cycle.
Virtual printer; local-only server; no public deployment.
